{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"611fce16-104e-4aca-8988-790533662469","result":{"tools":[{"name":"deploy-html","description":"Deploy HTML content to EdgeOne Pages, return the public URL","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"string","description":"HTML or text content to deploy. findings.spec_reference: Transports §Security: servers SHOULD authenticate all connections. A protected server MUST answer 401 when authorization is required.
findings.notes: tools/list returned 1 tool(s) without any credential.

findings.name: Cleartext HTTP transport (no TLS)
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §1.5 / MCP Authorization: auth-bearing traffic MUST use HTTPS (loopback exempt).

Provide complete HTML or text content you want to publish, and the system will return a public URL where
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: on 401 the server MUST return WWW-Authenticate indicating the protected-resource-metadata URL (RFC 9728 §5.1).
findings.notes: Server did not issue a 401/403, so the WWW-Authenticate MUST is not triggered (see no-authentication-remote for the real risk).

findings.name: Missing OAuth Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728)
findings.evidence:
https://mcp-on-edge.edgeone.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource -> HTTP 404
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charSet="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/><link rel="preload" href="/_next/static/media/e4af272ccee01ff0-s.p.woff2" as="font" crossorigin="" type="font/woff2"/><link rel="stylesheet" href="/_next/static/css/0beccdebd216f6ef.css" data-precedence="next"/><link rel="preload" as="script" fetchPriority="low" href=
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: servers MUST expose RFC 9728 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource including authorization_servers.
findings.notes: No metadata doc; server negotiated <2025-06-18 where 9728 is not a MUST.

findings.name: Session identifier carried in URL/query string
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §5: tokens MUST NOT appear in URI query. MCP Streamable HTTP moved the session to the Mcp-Session-Id header.
findings.notes: No header session id and no URL-borne session id observed.
